versions.changelog:
Initial release: provides complete quality culture maturity diagnosis, actionable roadmap, and behavior assessment for organizations.

- Enables self-assessment across 10 ISO 9001-anchored culture dimensions, generating a maturity score and shortfall profile.
- Offers phased (12-month) roadmap templates, tailored activity plans, and behavior-based evaluation checklists.
- Supports strategy alignment if a quality policy or strategy is provided; flags uncertainty if missing.
- Includes direct access to templates, sample cases, and recommended actions; all outputs are clearly marked if based on assumptions.
- Guides users through an interactive or document-based input workflow; highlights working boundaries and required information.
